item.title: Dumenza, three home burglaries and one failed attempt
item.description: Three homes targeted in Dumenza on the evening of Friday, September 25: cash, gold and money stolen. A fourth attempt failed.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Three thefts committed in Dumenza in a single evening - Via Santuario, via Fiume and via Dante targeted - 600 euros, gold and other money stolen - A fourth break-in failed on via XX Settembre
## Key facts - When → Friday 25 September - Where → Dumenza - Completed thefts → three - Failed attempts → one - Money stolen → 600 euros on via Santuario - Streets affected → via Santuario, via Fiume, via Dante and via XX Settembre - Investigations → Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station
### The four incidents
Three home burglaries successfully carried out and a fourth failed attempt over the course of a single evening. This is the sequence recorded in Dumenza on Friday 25 September, where several homes were targeted by unknown perpetrators.
On via Santuario, the thieves managed to enter a home and took 600 euros in cash. Another theft was reported on via Fiume: in this case too, the criminals managed to enter a house and, after searching for valuables, took gold.
A third theft was committed in a home on via Dante. In this case, the haul consisted of gold and money, taken before the perpetrators managed to get away and disappear without a trace.
The situation was different on via XX Settembre. The unknown individuals heard the owners inside the home and decided to flee. The theft was not completed, but in this incident too the perpetrators managed to disappear without a trace.
The incidents affected four streets in the small municipality north of Varese. In three homes the theft was completed, while in the fourth case the attempt was interrupted after the owners were heard inside the house. The people concerned reported the incidents to the Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station. ## The targeted homes
The reconstruction of the cases begins on via Santuario, where the reported haul was 600 euros in cash. On via Fiume, by contrast, the perpetrators searched for valuables inside the home and took gold.
The third incident, on via Dante, involved a haul consisting of gold and money. The perpetrators managed to get away after taking whatever they found in the home, disappearing without a trace. On via XX Settembre, the outcome was different: the presence of the owners prompted the unknown individuals to flee before the theft could be completed.
### Hauls and outcomes
| Street | Outcome | Haul or circumstances | |---|---|---| | via Santuario | Completed theft | 600 euros in cash | | via Fiume | Completed theft | Gold | | via Dante | Completed theft | Gold and money | | via XX Settembre | Failed attempt | The owners were at home |
The string of incidents is described as unfortunately record-breaking for the small municipality. The figure concerns the concentration of the incidents: three completed thefts and a fourth attempted break-in on the same evening. The homes are located on different streets, but all within the territory of Dumenza.
The evening thus resulted in four reports with two distinct outcomes. On the one hand, the thieves managed to enter three homes and steal cash, gold, or both. On the other, the attempt on via XX Settembre ended when the unknown individuals heard the residents. After fleeing, the perpetrators of the three completed thefts also disappeared without a trace.
The available information links the individual incidents to their respective addresses: via Santuario for the 600 euros, via Fiume for the gold, via Dante for gold and money, via XX Settembre for the failed attempt. The Dumenza Carabinieri Station is now focusing its investigations on this sequence. ## The Carabinieri investigation
Following reports from the people concerned, the Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station are carrying out investigations to reconstruct what happened and try to identify those responsible for the thefts.
The investigators' work concerns the sequence recorded on the evening of Friday 25 September, with three completed thefts and a fourth attempt that was not carried through. The checks concern the homes indicated on Via Santuario, Via Fiume, Via Dante and Via XX Settembre, where the incidents described occurred.
For the failed break-in, the reported circumstance is the presence of the owners inside the house. After hearing them, the unknown individuals decided to flee. In the other three cases, however, the perpetrators managed to enter the homes, take the items mentioned and leave without a trace.
### The request to residents
The appeal to the public is to report to the Carabinieri any suspicious people or cars noticed on Friday evening in the areas concerned. The request concerns not only the streets where the homes were targeted, but more generally the territory of Dumenza.
Any detail could prove useful to the investigation. For this reason, both observations possibly made in the areas of Via Santuario, Via Fiume, Via Dante and Via XX Settembre, and those collected in other areas of the municipality on the same evening, are being recalled.
Residents' reports add to those already submitted by the people affected by the thefts. The investigations by the Carabinieri of the local Station will reconstruct what happened and try to identify those responsible for the sequence of incidents recorded in Dumenza.

item.title: Como, jewelry store robbery: two more arrests
item.description: A 32-year-old resident of Switzerland and a 25-year-old from the province of Monza arrested for the 90mila euro robbery at Stroili in Tavernola.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Two arrests for the robbery at the Stroili store in Tavernola - The heist yielded gold worth approximately 90mila euro - The two arrested individuals reside in Switzerland and the Monza area - The robbery was committed on 24 aprile
## Key facts - Operation: two arrests - Location: Stroili jewelry store in the Bennet in Tavernola - Loot: gold jewelry worth approximately 90mila euro - Date of the robbery: 24 aprile - Suspects arrested: a 32-year-old and a 25-year-old - Authorities: Como State Police and the Public Prosecutor’s Office
### The latest operation
On 25 settembre, the Como State Police arrested two Italian nationals as part of the investigation into the robbery at the Stroili jewelry store inside the Bennet in Tavernola. The operation was coordinated by the Public Prosecutor’s Office and carried out pursuant to a pretrial detention order issued by the GIP of Como.
They are a 32-year-old resident of Switzerland and a 25-year-old resident of the province of Monza. According to the evidence gathered during the investigation, the two are believed to have been involved in the heist committed on 24 aprile, when four people with their faces covered reached the shopping center in a rental car.
The robbery took place within a few minutes. While one of the group waited in the car, the others entered the jewelry store armed with a pistol and with their faces concealed by balaclavas. They threatened the employees and smashed the glass display cases with hammers, taking numerous gold jewelry items.
The total value of the stolen jewelry was estimated at approximately 90mila euro. Due to its manner and speed, the action was described as resembling a scene from a Hollywood action film. ## The investigation into the gang
### The previous arrests
The arrests on September 25 represent a new stage in the investigative activity launched after the assault on the Bennet jewelry store in Tavernola. The Como Mobile Squad reconstructed the participants’ roles and gathered evidence considered significant against all those involved in the robbery.
The investigation also concerns the mastermind behind the heist. The source reports that the most recent operation forms part of a broader context, in which the other three members of the gang had already been arrested in April and May 2026. The robbery had been committed by four individuals, with tasks divided between those waiting outside and those entering the store.
During the investigations following the arrests, searches were carried out. Those activities also uncovered part of the stolen goods, before they could be fenced. The recovered jewelry was returned to the Stroili jewelry store, which had been targeted in the assault.
The reconstruction includes several details described by investigators: the rental car used to reach Bennet, the covered faces, the gun shown to the employees, and the hammers used to smash the display cases’ glass. The haul consisted of numerous gold jewelry items, taken within a matter of minutes.
The Mobile Squad’s work focused both on the actual execution of the robbery and on identifying the participants and the alleged mastermind. The previous arrests and searches added details to the reconstruction of the heist and enabled some of the jewelry to be recovered. ## What happens now
### The procedural phase
After notification of the pretrial detention order, the two men arrested on 25 September were taken to the Como Prison. Their position remains linked to the investigation records and the evidence gathered by the Como State Police, coordinated by the Public Prosecutor’s Office.
The next step indicated by the source is the confirmation in court of the evidence that emerged during the investigations. The arrests were carried out on the basis of the order issued by the GIP of Como, while the strength of the evidence gathered will have to be verified in the proceedings.
From an investigative standpoint, the most recent operation fits into a sequence that had already led to the arrest of the other three members of the gang in the months of April and May 2026. The searches had also made it possible to recover some of the jewelry stolen from Stroili and return it to the store.
The matter remains focused on the proceedings relating to the robbery on 24 April at Bennet in Tavernola. The elements cited include the haul of approximately 90mila euro, the involvement of four individuals with different roles, the use of a rental car and the action carried out with a pistol, balaclava and hammers.
For the two arrested men, the next stage will therefore be the procedural one, identified in the records as the venue for confirmation of the investigative evidence. Until that stage, the reconstruction remains the one that emerged from the work of the State Police, the Como Mobile Squad and the Public Prosecutor’s Office.

item.title: Claudio Zali's lifetime pension: political doubts
item.description: Mps deputies seek clarification on the early withdrawal of 700,000 francs and the pension calculation for the resigning minister
item.content:encoded:
## In brief
- Sergi and Pronzini ask for clarifications about Zali's pension entitlement - The order dismissing the case is dated 6 marzo 2019 - The advance withdrawal indicated is approximately 700mila franchi - The questions concern calculation, reduction and insurance period
- Main figures → Giuseppe Sergi and Matteo Pronzini, Mps deputies - Subject → Claudio Zali's pension case - Decision → order signed by Attorney General Andrea Pagani - Withdrawal → approximately 700mila franchi - Effective date → pension entitlement starting on 1° ottobre - Reform → parliamentary amendment during 2020
### The interpellation reopens an issue already discussed
Claudio Zali's departure from the Council of State of the Canton of Ticino prompted Giuseppe Sergi and Matteo Pronzini, Mps deputies, to submit an interpellation to the government. The two are asking for clarifications about the pension entitlement of the Lega minister who resigned and argue that his pension case is still far from clear. The issue had already emerged in 2018, after Pronzini's reports.
The reports led, in March of the following year, to an order dismissing the case signed by Attorney General Andrea Pagani with regard to Zali. The measure concerned the advance withdrawal intended to finance his primary residence, requested and obtained by the State Councillor in March 2016. The date indicated for the order is 6 marzo 2019.
### The move from the Court of Appeal to the government
Sergi and Pronzini start from that order. According to the interpellation, when Zali moved from the Court of Appeal to the Council of State, the occupational pension contributions were taken in by the Canton of Ticino, as provided for by the cited law. In return, the years spent in the service of the State as a teacher and magistrate would have been counted as years of service on the Council of State to determine the pension entitlement upon leaving the government.
The two parliamentarians' reading is that Zali had been entitled to the maximum pension entitlement from day one without paying a franc in pension contributions. They link this situation to the former pension rules for State Councillors, which they describe as still valid for the majority of the members of the current Executive.
The administrative chronology includes further steps. On 28 settembre 2015, an internal opinion from Ipct, sent by email to the entire Council of State by the then deputy director, indicated that the advance withdrawal would have an impact on the future pension entitlement. On 27 novembre 2015, Zali forwarded to Ipct the application for an advance withdrawal, a pledge arrangement and authorization for a registration notice in the land registry, for approximately 700mila franchi. On 2 dicembre 2015, the Council of State granted the withdrawal through a government resolution and indicated that it would entail a reduction in the pension entitlement. The amount had been reported by Corriere del Ticino on 8 maggio 2018.
During 2020, parliament amended the remuneration and pension provisions of members of the Executive. The resolution had reserved the right to review the calculation of the insurance period in the event of future rules. The questions now concern the reference annual salary, who calculated the pension entitlement Zali will receive starting on 1° ottobre, the percentage reduction linked to the 700mila franchi, and the effects of the amendment on the insurance period. ## What a cross-border worker can infer
### The source's practical limitation
For someone who is a cross-border worker and works in Ticino, the news has a precise scope. The text concerns Claudio Zali's pension and the operation of the pension scheme for members of the cantonal Executive. It does not present a change concerning the G permit, AVS, LPP, LAMal, remittances or withholding tax. These topics are not linked to the interpellation.
This distinction is necessary to avoid automatically transposing the case into the everyday life of a commuter. The approximately 700 thousand francs mentioned in the interpellation are the amount of the withdrawal requested by Zali and granted by the Council of State in the case described. The source does not present them as a parameter for a payslip or for the contributions of a cross-border worker. Nor does it provide a final value for the pension, an already calculated percentage or a reference annual salary: these are precisely some of the points on which Sergi and Pronzini are asking for an answer.
The text nevertheless makes it possible to distinguish three aspects. The first is the pension position accrued in the transition from the Appeals Court to the Council of State. The second is the effect that Ipct's internal opinion and the resolution of 2 December 2015 attributed to the early withdrawal. The third is the possible consequence of the 2020 parliamentary amendment on the calculation of the insurance period. The interpellation does not say that these three aspects have already been brought together in a definitive calculation.
For the cross-border reader, the question to keep in mind is therefore which information is documented and which remains to be clarified. The source documents the existence of the political request and reconstructs the cited acts; it does not document a new rule for those who cross the border. To navigate the separate topics of Permesso G/B and AVS/LPP e rendita, it is better not to use this case as a substitute for a specific guide. The topic of withholding tax is also not addressed by the article.
The most prudent reading is this: the case concerns an individual position held by a State Councillor, the rules applicable to that role and the questions addressed to the government. As long as the available material does not include the calculation, the response to the questions and the exact effects of the 2020 reform, any further conclusion about the pension treatment of a cross-border worker would remain outside the source.
## Useful planning tools To estimate your pension strategy, use the pension planner and the pillar 3 simulator. ## How to follow the dossier
### Four steps based on the cited documents
1. Start with the subject of the interpellation. The questions are addressed to the Council of State and concern the reference annual salary, the party that calculated the pension starting from 1° ottobre, the percentage reduction linked to the withdrawal of 700mila franchi, and the effect of the change in the calculation of the insurance period.
2. Keep the 2015 documents distinct. The internal Ipct opinion appears on 28 settembre 2015; Zali's question is dated 27 novembre 2015; the government resolution arrives on 2 dicembre 2015. This sequence makes it possible not to confuse the opinion with the decision.
3. Separate the judicial step from the administrative part. The order not to proceed of 6 marzo 2019 concerns the matter of the early withdrawal and bears the signature of public prosecutor Andrea Pagani. The source cites it as the starting point of the interpellation, not as a response to the four current questions.
4. Verify the point left open since 2020. Parliament changed the remuneration and pension provision of Executive members; the 2015 resolution had reserved the right to review and amend the calculation of the insurance period in the event of new rules. The interpellation asks what effect that change had on Zali's pension. The text provided does not report the government's response.
For a cross-border reader, this is a reading procedure, not a form to fill out. The source does not indicate documents to submit, offices to contact, or a deadline for sending personal questions. It does, however, indicate the names of the acts and institutions that make up the matter: Ipct, Council of State, parliament, Court of Appeal and public prosecutor. These are the coordinates not to mix up when trying to understand whether a figure concerns a withdrawal, a reduction in the pension or the calculation of the years.
It is not possible to derive from this reconstruction a calculation for one's own payslip, nor an answer about pension provision or withholding tax. For this reason, the case should be kept separate from personal tools dedicated to cross-border work. If the question concerns your own net pay and deductions, use Frontaliere Ticino's calcolatore stipendio.

## The game will be decided by the rotations
The value of the test lies not only in the strength of the opponents, but in the need to build a team during the game. Varese and Bologna still have to define their pecking order, and the absences make the coaches' choices more visible. For Openjobmetis, the problem is above all distributing the playmaking duties and maintaining offensive incisiveness without two players who, when available, improve the team's overall performance.
### Varese, playmaking duties to be shared
McDowell-White's certain absence leaves game management to Librizzi, Hale and Duke. Their task will be shared, with attention also focused on Librizzi's fouls. Hunter will be called upon more than expected to be the team's primary offensive option, a role he likes anyway. David, on the other hand, will also have to make an impact in plays when the ball is in the hands of the others.
This distribution does not establish a definitive pecking order, but reflects the emergency situation described on the eve of the game. If Della Valle does not play, the solution will be the one already tested during the preseason; if he is listed, his presence could change the rotations. The final choice also concerns Villa, whom Kastritis could use as the twelfth man or as the eleventh if Della Valle is listed only to make up the numbers.
| Key matchup issue | Reading based on the source | |---|---| | McDowell-White | Certain absence and playmaking duties to be redistributed | | Della Valle | His involvement in doubt after separate training | | Hunter and David | Greater responsibility in creation and offensive incisiveness | | Kamagate and Roby | Progress and consistency needed under the basket | | Renfro and Nikolic | Possible starters and support from the bench |
Under the basket, Kamagate will have to confirm further progress and Roby find consistency. Renfro could start and will have plenty of minutes in any case, while Nikolic, a former player in this matchup, is indicated as an additional resource.
### Bologna must choose whom to leave out
Mumbrù has a deep roster and will have to decide whom not to include. The choice could come in the hours immediately preceding the tip-off. Bologna circles identify Bello and Klintman as possible exclusions, but the contest remains open. This too makes Virtus harder to read on the eve of the game.

item.title: Varese-Season 1-1: Manganese for 95'rigour
item.description: Varese snatches a point from Lentigione thanks to Mangano’s decisive save in stoppage time, after Beretta’s goal and Bontempi’s equalizer.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Beretta puts Varese ahead in the 4th minute - Bontempi equalizes in the 40th minute of the second half - Mangano saves Nappo's penalty in stoppage time - Varese-Lentigione ends 1-1
## Key facts - Match → Varese-Lentigione 1-1 - Lead → Beretta in the 4th minute of the first half - Equalizer → Bontempi in the 40th minute of the second half - Decisive save → Mangano saves Nappo's penalty - Stadium → Franco Ossola - Next fixture → Crema - Coppa Italia → Pro Patria at Masnago on Wednesday 7 October
### A point defended in stoppage time In the 4th minute of the first half, Varese broke the deadlock against Lentigione. Beretta exchanged passes with Favale, entered the box and beat Mosca with an inside-foot touch that went in at the far post. The goal put the biancorossi 1-0 up after a strong start. Varese's defense held firm and the lead stood without much trouble, although Varese's attack failed to make an impact.
The match remained 1-0 to the biancorossi until the end of the second half. The visitors, who played almost entirely in Varese's half in the second half, increased the pressure and in the 40th minute found space for the equalizer. Jassey crossed from the right, Bontempi was left unmarked in the box and headed in the 1-1.
After the goal, Lentigione continued to push. Almost as the five minutes of stoppage time were about to expire, another turning point came: the referee awarded the Emilian side a penalty for Bruzzone pulling Bontempi. Nappo took it, but Mangano guessed the side and saved the shot. The penalty duel was thus won by the Varese goalkeeper, who preserved the 1-1 and allowed the team to take at least a point.
The result moves the team up the table, but cannot make the Franco Ossola happy, as it had hoped to celebrate the season's first home win. Varese had the lead, defended it for a long time and then risked losing it late on. Mangano's save prevented Lentigione's comeback and secured the draw, leaving the biancorossi with a point after a second half considered too passive. ## The match setup
### The initial choices The return to the Franco Ossola came after Varese had broken the duck at Pontedera with their first league win. The Biancorossi were therefore looking to give their fans the season's first home joy. However, a far-from-soft Lentigione arrived at Masnago, a team aiming for a high finish in the table and coming off three consecutive wins before being beaten 1-0 at home by Cittadella Modena.
Ciceri set Varese up in a 4-3-3, dropping De Ponti back into defense to make room for Piantoni in midfield alongside Malinverno and Beretta. Favale, Barzotti and Bianchi started up front. Lentigione chose the same formation. Pedrelli, suspended, was replaced on the bench by Costa; in midfield the visitors fielded former player Battistello, while Mascanzoni, with Jassey and Alessandrini, led the attacking line.
### The first-half chances The opening minutes were a feeling-out period, until the first Biancorossi attack. In the 6th minute, Varese tried to double their lead, but Favale struck a poor shot from outside the box after a fine move. Lentigione took a few minutes to make their presence felt, and Mangano was immediately alert to Battistello's through ball for Mascanzoni. In the 13th minute, the goalkeeper came off his line low to stop Alessandrini, played through vertically by Mascanzoni.
Ciceri's side continued to keep danger at bay thanks to high, organized pressing, which allowed them to win back possession well away from Mangano's goal. The match remained without any major chances until the 25th minute, when the referee awarded Lentigione an indirect free kick inside the box. The move had originated from a back pass by Salera, clearly deflected by an opposing attacker, which Mangano had then caught with his hands.
The decision prompted protests from Varese and Ciceri's disapproval. Nappo, however, fired over, prompting a sigh of relief at the Franco Ossola. In the 34th minute, the Emilian side created their real chance of the first half with a ground-based move involving all three attackers: Mascanzoni finished centrally and Mangano parried.
Late in the half, Lentigione tried to push forward with greater intensity. Varese dropped back a few yards, without allowing themselves to be pinned back, and also held firm against the visitors' corners. The Biancorossi side thus reached halftime still maintaining their lead. ## The follow-up between Crema and the Coppa Italia
### The next appointment Next week, Varese will be playing in Crema. The away match is seen as an opportunity to seek another positive result and find the necessary momentum ahead of the next commitment. In fact, on Wednesday, October 7th, Pro Patria will arrive at Masnago for the Coppa Italia challenge.
The course of events is therefore already outlined: first the match in Crema, then the home match against Pro Patria. For Varese, these will be the next two scheduled appointments following the draw with Lentigione, with the search for a positive result and the cup match set in Masnago.
### Varese Match Report The match report lists Mangano in goal; Salera, De Ponti, Bruzzone, and Berbenni in defense; Malinverno, Piantoni, and Beretta in midfield; Favale, Barzotti, and Bianchi in attack. The indicated formation is 4-3-3, with Ciceri as coach.
During the second half, Varese used Sovogui for Favale at 21', Costante for Piantoni at 27', Fabris for Bianchi at 31', Molinari for Beretta at 43', and Tronci for Berbenni at 44'. Gruttadauria, Dodaj, Ndagijimana, and Gallotti were available on the bench.
### Lentigione Match Report Lentigione took the field with Mosca; Capiluppi, Mele, Gobbo, and Bita in defense; Battistello, Nappo, and Giorgi in midfield; Jassey, Mascanzoni, and Alessandrini in attack. The reported formation for the visitors is also 4-3-3.
In the 25th minute of the second half, Bontempi replaced Capiluppi and Chiesa replaced Giorgi. Delti, Addiego Mobilio, Gualtieri, Mordini, Landini, and Buci were on the bench. The match report thus completes the picture of the game before the double stretch of matches awaiting Varese: the away trip to Crema and the Coppa Italia challenge against Pro Patria in Masnago.

item.title: Icesport Varese: Open Day for over 100 kids on the ice
item.description: On Saturday 5 September, Icesport Varese's Open Day attracted over one hundred children and young people onto the ice, with most groups nearing capacity.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Open Day Icesport Varese on September 5 - More than one hundred children and young people on the ice - Courses are nearing capacity - Alessandra Trusiani makes her Élite debut in Bolzano
## Key facts Event → Open Day Icesport Varese; Date → Saturday, September 5
Participants → more than one hundred children and young people; Registrations → most groups nearing capacity
Competition → first event of the Italian Élite category championship; Location → Bolzano
Athlete → Alessandra Trusiani, Junior category; Programs → renewed short program and free program refined compared with last season
On Saturday, September 5, the Open Day promoted by Icesport Varese brought more than one hundred children and young people onto the ice. In the afternoon, participants were able to lace up their skates, take their first steps and get to know the activities of the Varese club up close.
The response had an immediate effect on registrations. Two weeks before the courses began, Icesport is recording a boom in registrations and most groups are nearing capacity. Among those enrolled are former athletes who have chosen to resume their activity and young people taking their first steps in figure skating and synchronized skating.
«We are very satisfied with the response we received from the city of Varese — explain Icesport's management —. It is a great satisfaction to see so many families choose our club again and, at the same time, to see so many children and young people approach skating for the first time.»
### A start on two fronts
The Open Day thus marks the start of the new sports season in terms of course participation. The club is experiencing a period of strong interest both from those returning to the ice and those trying it for the first time. The reference remains Icesport Varese and the work carried out over the years, described by its management as the foundation of a path appreciated by the city.
At the same time, the competitive sector is already getting underway. Over the weekend, Bolzano hosts the first event of the Italian Élite category championship, defined as the highest level of national figure skating. For Icesport Varese, in the Junior category, Alessandra Trusiani takes to the ice.
For the Varese athlete, this marks her return to competitive action after the hiatus that began in January, linked to a study stay in Canada. In Bolzano, she will present a renewed short program and a free program refined compared with last season. The news thus brings together two distinct moments: approaching the sport through the courses and resuming high-level competitive activity. The connection with Frontaliere Ticino's audience is territorial: the news concerns Varese and a sports club in the city. Its practical content is not a change to an employment relationship, but an overview of the sporting opportunities for children, young people, former athletes and families who follow local activities.
The first element to consider is the pressure on registrations. The Open Day attracted over one hundred participants and, two weeks before the start of the courses, most of the groups were close to being fully booked. The combination of the two data points describes already high demand, but does not authorize drawing conclusions about the places remaining, fees, schedules or access procedures. These are pieces of information the source does not provide and should not be replaced with assumptions.
### A local connection, not a tax-related one
For a cross-border commuter, therefore, the article can be read as an update on a sports organization in Varese, without turning it into news about working across the border. The source does not mention the G permit, AVS, LPP or LAMal; it does not address tax rebates, withholding tax, INPS, Canton Ticino, Brogeda, the new 2026 tax agreement or double taxation. These topics cannot be presented as effects of the Open Day.
The analysis instead remains focused on the two paths described by Icesport. On one side there are young people making their first contact with figure skating or synchronized skating; on the other, former athletes returning. They are different profiles, but the source places them within the same seasonal restart. For anyone considering a choice, the most concrete fact is that interest was strong and that several groups are nearing capacity.

item.title: Trofeo Binda: appointment on March 14, 2027
item.description: Cittiglio confirms itself as the capital of women's cycling: 14 marzo 2027 sees the return of the Trofeo Binda WorldTour and the junior event in the Valli del Verbano.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief
- The Trofeo Binda returns on Sunday, 14 March 2027. - Cittiglio hosts the Trofeo and the junior race. - The starting location will be unveiled on 16 October. - The two races will finish in Alfredo Binda's hometown.
## Key facts
- Main race → Trofeo Alfredo Binda – Comune di Cittiglio - Junior race → Piccolo Trofeo Alfredo Binda – Valli del Verbano - Date → Sunday, 14 March 2027 - Circuit → UCI Women's WorldTour - Starting announcement → 16 October, at the headquarters of the Comunità Montana Valli del Verbano
### Confirmation for 2027
On Sunday, 14 March 2027, Cittiglio will once again be at the heart of women's cycling with a day built around two competitions. The programme will bring together the Trofeo Alfredo Binda – Comune di Cittiglio, an UCI Women's WorldTour event, and the Piccolo Trofeo Alfredo Binda – Valli del Verbano, reserved for junior women.
The format includes two separate moments on the same day. In the morning, the young riders of the Piccolo Trofeo will race, while in the afternoon it will be the turn of the WorldTour champions. For both races, the finish will be in Cittiglio, Alfredo Binda's hometown. This is where the entire event announced by the Valli del Verbano will conclude.
The announcement about the next edition comes as the Road World Championships are taking place in Montréal. The return of the international classic and the junior race is therefore already set for the date indicated, with Cittiglio once again at the centre of the day dedicated to women's competitions.
The double event brings together different levels of women's cycling: on one hand, the competition reserved for juniors, and on the other, the race included in the UCI Women's WorldTour international circuit. The two races are presented as a single sporting event, with the morning dedicated to the young riders and the afternoon to the elite athletes.
The next edition will therefore not be just one race, but a day structured around two competitions with the same finish. The first piece of information made public is the date; the starting location will be announced at a later time, at the event already scheduled for October. ## The results from Montréal
The announcement of the date is accompanied by two world medals that strengthen the connection between the Cittiglio race and international cycling. The results came during the Road World Championships held in Montréal and concern both categories highlighted by the Binda event.
Matilde Rossignoli, who won the Piccolo Trofeo Binda in Cittiglio last March, won the silver medal in the junior world championship event in Montréal. The young athlete's result directly connects the race reserved for juniors with the world stage: the winner of the last edition mentioned reached the podium in the world championship competition in the same category.
Among the elite, Elisa Longo Borghini won bronze. The cyclist had already won Binda in 2013 and 2021, two previous victories mentioned alongside the new result achieved in Canada. The two medals thus accompany confirmation of the next event and highlight the relationship between the Cittiglio competition and the world championships.
| Athlete | Result in Montréal | Link with Binda | |---|---|---| | Matilde Rossignoli | Silver in the junior world championship event | Winner of the Piccolo Trofeo in Cittiglio last March | | Elisa Longo Borghini | Bronze among the elite | Winner of Binda in 2013 and 2021 |
### The organization's work
From Montréal, Mario Minervino, president of Cycling Sport Promotion, explained that work on the 2027 edition has already begun. His statement reflects the desire to once again create a great day of women's cycling together with the institutions, communities and all the people who support the organization.
> «We have already begun working on the 2027 edition – Mario Minervino, president of Cycling Sport Promotion, explains from Montréal –. Once again, we want to create a great day of women's cycling together with the institutions, communities and everyone who supports us».
During his stay in Canada for the World Championships, Minervino also met with David Lappartient, president of the UCI. The results of Rossignoli and Longo Borghini, the words of the president of Cycling Sport Promotion and the meeting with the head of the UCI accompany confirmation of the new edition of the Trofeo Binda. ## The next event is on 16 ottobre
The first step toward the 2027 edition is scheduled for 16 ottobre at the headquarters of the Comunità Montana Valli del Verbano. On that occasion, the starting location of the two competitions will be announced, completing the first information made public about the next event in Cittiglio.
The announcement will cover both the Trofeo Alfredo Binda – Comune di Cittiglio and the Piccolo Trofeo Alfredo Binda – Valli del Verbano. It is therefore not the presentation of a single race: the location announced will be the starting point for the two races scheduled for Sunday 14 marzo 2027.
### The venue for the announcement
President Simone Castoldi will host the event. The headquarters of the Comunità Montana Valli del Verbano will thus host the moment when the starting point of the competitions will be revealed, while their finish is already set for Cittiglio, the birthplace of Alfredo Binda.
The schedule of the next stages is already defined. The start will be announced on 16 ottobre; 14 marzo 2027, meanwhile, will see the women's cycling day take place. The young riders of the Piccolo Trofeo will be the protagonists in the morning race, while the WorldTour champions will race in the afternoon. The junior race and the one included in the UCI Women's WorldTour will therefore remain united in the same event, with two distinct moments and a shared finish in Cittiglio.
The October announcement represents the first step toward the new edition. The race date has been confirmed by the Valli del Verbano, while the starting location will be made public at the headquarters of the Comunità Montana. The countdown to Cittiglio has already begun.

item.description: Ilaria Flute disputes the transfer of the Nazario Sauro primary school to IC Como Lago in the 2027/28 plan: ten years of educational work risk being cancelled.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief
- Municipal plan for the school network in 2027/2028 - Via Perti proposed for transfer to IC Como Lago - Nazario Sauro moved to IC Como Borgovico in 2016 - Ilaria Flauto calls for a discussion on educational continuity
## Key facts
- Who → Ilaria Flauto, teacher and vice-principal - School → Nazario Sauro primary school, Via Tomaso Perti - Destination → IC Como Lago - References → points 4.4.4 and 4.4.5 - Resources → PNRR and PN 21-27 - Continuity → from ages three to fourteen
### The disputed transfer
For the 2027/2028 school year, the Municipality of Como proposed a reorganization of the city's school network. The document, included in the debate on the reorganization sought by the administration of Mayor Alessandro Rapinese, indicates in points 4.4.4 and 4.4.5 the transfer of the Via Tomaso Perti school complex to IC Como Lago. The Nazario Sauro Primary School is located in the school complex, the school from which Ilaria Flauto's reflection originates.
Flauto writes in her dual capacity as a teacher at Nazario Sauro and as vice-principal and primary school coordinator for IC Como Borgovico. The assessment she submits to the editorial office is clear-cut: the choice, examined from a pedagogical and regulatory perspective, causes concern and dismay. In her reading, the issue concerns the way the school is viewed: not as a simple sum of numbers or as a school complex to be moved based on accounting or demographic needs, but as a community built over time.
### Continuity as a criterion
The teacher refers to school legislation and the National Guidelines. The Comprehensive Institute, she explains, was created to ensure vertical teaching and educational continuity, from ages three to fourteen. A unified pathway should therefore bring together a cultural, methodological, and social identity rooted in the local area.
Nazario Sauro had already changed institutes in 2016, moving from IC Como Centro Città to IC Como Borgovico. Since then, according to the letter, the teachers' work has built a cohesive and integrated educational community. The phrase Flauto chose to describe this transfer is direct: «In these ten years, we have not been a postal package».
The letter recalls the teamwork and the use of national resources, citing PNRR and PN 21-27. The results mentioned include a shared horizontal and vertical curriculum, continuous teacher training, joint projects in music, sports, art, and language, as well as the design of educational spaces funded by the PNRR.
### The consequences indicated
For Flauto, removing Nazario Sauro from IC Como Borgovico would change its identity, also because the institute is set to be renamed IC Como Nord Ovest and would lose its historic primary school in the city center. The letter also links the closure of Corridoni primary school and the transfer of its student population to IC Como Centro Città to the breaking of continuity with Raschi nursery school and Foscolo secondary school.
The final request is addressed to the institutions: a politely firm, open, and competent discussion, with teaching quality and the stability of students' educational pathways at the center. ## A practical reading of the reorganization
Flauto proposes a framework for reading the transfer. It is not enough to identify the receiving institution: the letter invites one to observe the ties built around the school complex and the support they provide to the students' educational path. The source focuses attention on four elements of the work carried out at IC Como Borgovico.
| Area | Element described in the letter | |---|---| | Curriculum | shared methodology and mission, coordinated across school levels | | Teachers | continuous professional development, inclusion and shared planning | | Network | music, sports, artistic and language projects | | Spaces | environments designed for creativity and inclusion, with PNRR resources |
The shared curriculum connects the institute's primary schools with its nursery schools and lower secondary school. According to the teacher, continuous training has unified the educational language, inclusion strategies and planning documents. The letter presents these elements as parts of the same pedagogical mission, not as isolated initiatives.
The musical, sports, artistic and linguistic synergies add daily collaboration among teachers from the different school levels. The learning environments, designed with PNRR resources, are described as serving creativity and inclusion, within the institute's overall vision. The practical point is the connection between people, tools and spaces.
### The criterion for evaluating the change
The consequence pointed out by the letter is therefore not simply a change of label. If the school complexes are treated as isolated and interchangeable entities, relationships, families' trust and the professional heritage accumulated by teachers are separated. According to Flauto, this weakens the very meaning of school planning and makes it more difficult to protect the stability of educational pathways.
The transition must be read within a complete network: primary, early childhood and secondary education, but also connections among teachers. The letter recalls the relationship with Raschi and Foscolo and describes the closure of Corridoni primary school, with the transfer of the school population to IC Como Centro Città, as a break in natural continuity.

item.title: Bellinzona rejects the «fortress» project
item.description: 54% of voters rejected the 19,1-million plan to enhance and modernize the UNESCO site of the Bellinzona castles; turnout at 47,5%.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Bellinzona rejected the «fortress» project - The no vote reached 54% of the votes - The plan provided for 19.1 million francs - Voter turnout was 47.5%
## Key facts - Outcome → 54% opposed and 46% in favor - Turnout → 47.5% - Investment → 19.1 million francs - City's share → approximately 4.5 million francs - Objective → enhancement and modernization of the UNESCO site
### The result in Bellinzona The vote by Bellinzona's citizens halted the project called «fortress», supported by the municipal executive, the City Council and the civic committee «Facciamoci Belli». Opponents obtained 54%, while supporters stopped at 46%. Voter turnout was 47.5%.
The proposal concerned the enhancement of Bellinzona's castles and aimed to relaunch and modernize the UNESCO site. The total planned investment amounted to 19.1 million francs. The plan was largely supported by the Canton, the Confederation and private parties, with a share of approximately 4.5 million francs borne by the City.
The consultation came after intense debate, a signature-gathering campaign and the subsequent popular vote. The result therefore concerns a project already supported by the municipal executive, the City Council and the civic committee in favor, but rejected by the majority of voters. The consultation figures combine the political outcome and turnout: the no vote prevailed with 54%, supporters garnered 46% and turnout was 47.5%.
The plan submitted to citizens had a precise financial scope and a defined objective. On the one hand, it provided for an investment of 19.1 million francs, with approximately 4.5 million francs borne by the City. On the other, it had been conceived to give new impetus to the UNESCO site of the castles through enhancement and modernization. The project therefore linked the enhancement of the castles to an investment supported by multiple parties, involving the City, the Canton, the Confederation and private parties. The vote rejected the proposal supported by the civic bodies in favor. ## The debate on the project
### The opposing committee The vote took place after a heated discussion around the proposal’s approach. The project had been at the center of a broad debate, which had first led to the collection of signatures and then to the popular vote. The opposition mobilization had a precise structure: the committee was mainly associated with Noce and was led by former mayor Brenno Martignoni-Polti.
Avanti con Ticino&Lavoro, Partito comunista, HelvEthica and the Movimento per il socialismo had taken sides in support of that position. The front also included various prominent figures, among them democentrist deputy Tuto Rossi and architect Cristiana Storelli. The campaign against the project thus brought together a local committee, political forces and figures who had intervened in the debate on the enhancement of the castles.
### Costs, management and access The objections did not concern just one element. Among the points contested were the project’s costs and the management model envisaged for enhancing the castles. The opposing committee had also challenged the designation «Fortress», considered to be at the expense of the term «castles».
Another issue was paid access to the inner courtyard of Castelgrande and the Murata gallery. The discussion therefore concerned the cost of the operation, the organization of management, the name under which to present the complex and the methods of access to specific places.
The transition from the collection of signatures to the popular vote brought these points to the attention of the citizens of Bellinzona. The final result rejected the project supported by the proponents, but the objections described concerned costs, management, designation and paid access. The local debate focused on the costs and on how to manage and designate the complex, as well as on access to the inner courtyard of Castelgrande and the Murata gallery. ### The next step with the Canton Asked by RSI, mayor Mario Branda admitted his disappointment with the outcome of the vote. His reaction starts from the work already carried out: he recalled that the project had been in the works for a long time and had required a financial and human investment.
> «The project had been in the works for a long time: there was a financial and human investment.»
Branda explained that the rejection poses an obstacle, but does not compromise the project on which hopes had been placed to give Bellinzona fresh impetus from an economic, tourism and cultural standpoint. The mayor's reaction therefore combines disappointment over the vote with the possibility of considering how to proceed with the proposal.
The mayor recalled that the castles are owned by the Canton. He also stressed that the project had been sponsored by the City and the Canton. For this reason, after the vote, he indicated the need for contact with the cantonal authorities: the discussion will have to serve to understand what they think and what can be done now.
Branda specified that what happens next will not be such a foregone conclusion. The indicated step therefore remains linked to discussions between the City and the cantonal authorities, which own the castles and were involved in sponsoring the project. The result of the vote has opened this phase of dialogue following the public rejection.
In the same reaction, Branda admitted that the Municipal Council and those in favor had not been sufficiently effective in explaining the project. This is the self-criticism expressed by the mayor regarding the promoters' communication. The indicated next step remains contact with the cantonal authorities and an assessment of the possibilities following the rejection expressed by the citizens.

item.title: Como 1907 opens the Sinigaglia to private events and meetings
item.description: The club launches the Corporate Collection: Trophy Room, terraces, Club House and executive suites available outside matchdays. Up to 160 guests per space.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Como 1907 opens the Sinigaglia to private events. - The Corporate Collection gathers stadium spaces. - The Trophy Room can host up to 40 guests. - Terraces and Club House accommodate up to 160 guests.
## Key facts - Project: Sinigaglia Corporate Collection - Location: Giuseppe Sinigaglia Stadium in Como - Promoter: Como 1907 - Availability: outside match days - Spaces: Trophy Room, East and West Terraces, Club House, six Executive Suites
### The Sinigaglia as an event space
Como 1907 recently presented the Sinigaglia Corporate Collection, making a series of venues within the Giuseppe Sinigaglia Stadium in Como available. The offering is designed for corporate meetings, private events, brand experiences, and hospitality initiatives that take place outside match days.
The novelty concerns the way of using a facility known for its history, its glory, and its views over Lake Como. A meeting, a private dinner, or a reception can thus be organized inside the stadium, in a place the club presents as a special office, with the pitch, the lake, and the surrounding landscape.
The collection brings together the Trophy Room, the East and West Terraces, the Club House, and six Executive Suites. Each venue has its own function and capacity. The proposal starts from the club's most intimate historic space and extends to rooms and terraces capable of hosting larger groups, while maintaining a connection to the Sinigaglia's history.
According to Como 1907, those who choose these spaces do not merely book a room or a venue. They step into the club's history, surrounded by the pitch, the lake, and the memories of the generations that have made the stadium their home. This is the trait the project places at the center: the event experience depends also on the place where it takes place, not only on its organization.
The presentation of the Corporate Collection thus expands the possible uses of the stadium beyond matches. The venues are offered for corporate and private occasions, with different solutions within the same facility. Como 1907 thus links the club's history to the possibility of hosting meetings and receptions in a stadium tied to the city. ### The spaces and their features
The Trophy Room occupies the central place in the collection due to its historic and intimate character. It is surrounded by trophies, objects and stories from Como 1907's past. It can accommodate up to 40 guests and is suitable for executive meetings, private dinners, receptions and high-level brand events.
The East Terrace connects an indoor area with direct access to the terrace. The view includes the stadium and surrounding landscape; with a capacity of 160 guests, the space is intended for receptions, press conferences, networking and private events. On the opposite side of the stadium, near the Curva del Como, the West Terrace is located in an elevated position. The room and adjacent terrace overlook the pitch and Lake Como and can accommodate up to 160 people, allowing guests to alternate between the energy of the stadium and the outdoor landscape.
At the heart of the stadium is the Club House, a flexible space for up to 160 guests. Its size and adaptable layout make it suitable for conferences, product launches, dinners and large corporate gatherings. It can also become the focal point of an event spread across multiple areas of the stadium.
The most intimate part of the offering consists of the six Executive Suites. Each is designed for groups of up to 15 guests and as an elegant private living room, rather than a classic stadium box. The design draws inspiration from the historic villas and decorative traditions of Lake Como. Italian and European furnishings from the 19th and early 20th centuries coexist with original vintage jerseys, photographs, newspaper clippings and objects connected to the club's history.
Each suite evokes a different figure from the history of Como 1907. The character and contribution of these figures thus become part of the space, which offers a private view of the pitch and mountains. The suites are designed for receptions, meetings and tailored hospitality, with an intimate atmosphere. ### The club's availability and vision
The rooms in the Corporate Collection can be booked individually or combined to create a route within the Sinigaglia. This possibility makes it possible to build an event across multiple parts of the venue, using different spaces without leaving the stadium. For selected projects, the entire stadium is also available. In this case, brands and organizations can create experiences in one of the most distinctive settings in Italian football. The offering is therefore not limited to a single room: the collection can be used as a group of spaces, or extended to the entire venue when the project calls for it.
Operational support includes high-speed connectivity, audiovisual equipment and dedicated event assistance. These services are complemented by an internal car park with a maximum capacity of 70 cars. These are elements connected to the offering presented by Como 1907 to support meetings, receptions and other experiences in the spaces of the Sinigaglia.
Ryan Shelton, Chief Business Officer of Como 1907 and Sent Entertainment, stated:
> «What makes the Sinigaglia special is not simply what can be hosted here. It is the place where people meet.»
The statement therefore emphasizes not only the activities, but also the place where they take place. Shelton referred to three images of the proposal: a meeting within the Club's history, a dinner with a view of the pitch and a reception with Lake Como beyond the terrace. The executive explained that these situations convey an atmosphere belonging to the stadium and the city.
He also recalled that for almost a century the Sinigaglia has brought people together. According to the statement, the Corporate Collection offers companies, brands and private groups a new way to become part of the history of the place.

item.title: Dumenza, three home burglaries and a failed heist
item.description: Three homes were targeted on via Santuario, via Fiume and via Dante. On via XX Settembre, the thieves fled after hearing the owners.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Three burglaries committed in Dumenza in a single evening - Via Santuario, via Fiume and via Dante targeted - The break-in on via XX Settembre failed - The Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station are investigating
## Key facts - What: three burglaries and one attempted burglary - When: Friday 25 September - Where: via Santuario, via Fiume, via Dante and via XX Settembre - Loot on via Santuario: 600 euros in cash - Loot on via Fiume: gold - Loot on via Dante: gold and money - Outcome on via XX Settembre: escape after the owners were present - Investigation: Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station
Three burglaries were carried out and a fourth attempted over the course of a single evening. This is what happened in Dumenza on Friday 25 September, with several homes targeted by unknown individuals and the Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station engaged in the investigation.
One of the burglaries took place on via Santuario. The thieves managed to enter the home and took away 600 euros in cash. In this case, the loot consisted of money.
Another incident was reported on via Fiume. Here too, the criminals managed to get inside a house; after searching for valuables, they took away some gold.
The third burglary was carried out on via Dante. Gold and money were stolen from this home before the perpetrators managed to leave and disappear without a trace.
The fourth case concerns via XX Settembre and had a different outcome. The burglary was not completed: the unknown individuals heard the owners inside the home and decided to flee. They too managed to disappear without a trace.
The homes involved were therefore four, located on four different streets. In three cases, the thieves’ entry ended with property being stolen: cash on via Santuario, gold on via Fiume, and gold and money on via Dante. In the fourth incident, however, the residents’ presence interrupted the action.
The people involved reported the incidents to the Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station, who are working to reconstruct the sequence of events. The fact that emerges from the evening is the concentration of four incidents in homes in Dumenza. The streets indicated are via Santuario, via Fiume, via Dante and via XX Settembre, with three completed thefts and one interrupted attempt.
The loot also reflects different situations. In via Santuario, 600 euros in cash were taken; in via Fiume, the perpetrators searched for valuables and stole gold; in via Dante, they took gold and money.
### The Interrupted Break-In
The events on via XX Settembre differ from those at the other addresses. The unknown individuals had begun their action, but the presence of the owners inside the home prompted them to give up. The theft thus remained at the attempted stage, and the thieves fled.
In the other three cases, however, entry into the home was followed by the theft of property. In via Santuario, the loot consisted of cash; in via Fiume, of gold; in via Dante, of gold and money. After leaving, the perpetrators vanished without a trace.
The perpetrators are described as unknown individuals or criminals. The people concerned reported what had happened to the Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station, who are carrying out investigations to reconstruct the various stages of the evening.
The reports concern the same evening, Friday 25 September, but four homes with different outcomes. The picture includes cash, gold, gold and money, as well as an attempt without a completed theft. The presence of the owners therefore changed the outcome of the incident on via XX Settembre, while at the other addresses the thieves managed to get away after taking the property. The follow-up to the incident is entrusted to the investigations by the Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station. The officers are trying to reconstruct what happened in the four homes and identify those responsible for the burglaries, as reported after the notifications from the people involved.
At the time of the report, the perpetrators remain unknown. After carrying out the three burglaries, they managed to get away without leaving a trace; on via XX Settembre, they fled after hearing the owners.
### The appeal to residents
The message addressed to the public concerns any suspicious people or cars. Residents are urged to report to the Carabinieri any noticed on Friday evening in the areas concerned or, more generally, in the Dumenza area. The request is part of the investigations already begun by the local Station.
The appeal is not limited to the streets where the incidents were reported. The source also refers to the Dumenza area as a whole, focusing on observations gathered on Friday evening. According to the appeal, any information could prove useful to the investigation.
The information requested is therefore connected to the four incidents: the three burglaries on via Santuario, via Fiume and via Dante, and the attempted burglary on via XX Settembre. The aim of the investigations remains to reconstruct what happened and try to identify those responsible.
For now, the indicated course of action is the Carabinieri's investigations and the appeal to residents. Residents are being asked to provide any useful information, while the Carabinieri continue their investigations.

item.title: October with Millestrade: open doors, internships and TicinoSkills
item.description: The orientation month with Millestrade starts from 3 October in Gordola: visits to the centres, technical internships and TicinoSkills championships for young people and families.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - On 3 October, the Gordola Training Center opens to the public. - TicinoSkills 2026: workshops and regional championships. - October offers internships, workshops and orientation days. - Millestrade brings together DECS events.
## Key facts - Main event: 3 October, from 9 to 16, in Gordola - Anniversary: 50 years of the SSIC Training Center - Organization: DECS, DFP, UOSP and Città dei mestieri - Awards ceremony: at 15, during TicinoSkills 2026
### The opening in Gordola
On Saturday 3 October, the Gordola Training Center will open its doors to young people, families and the public on the occasion of TicinoSkills 2026. From 9 to 16, it will be possible to enter the workshops and discover up close the professions in the construction, crafts and technology sectors. The public will also be able to attend the TicinoSkills regional skills championships and observe female and male apprentices putting the skills acquired during their training to the test.
The Gordola event will open the month of practical orientation organized through the Millestrade calendar. The platform brings together open days, internships, orientation days and workshops dedicated to the world of vocational training. Millestrade falls under the Department of Education, Culture and Sport, referred to in the source by the acronym DECS, and is coordinated by the Vocational Training Division, DFP, together with the School and Vocational Guidance Office, UOSP, and Città dei mestieri della Svizzera italiana.
The calendar is aimed particularly at young people and families. The events make it possible to meet people already working and to experience different professional activities and settings. The month's offerings therefore alternate between visits to workshops, meetings with experts in the field, practical experiences and opportunities to learn more about professions in construction, crafts, technology and other fields featured in the program.
The day in Gordola will also coincide with the celebrations for the 50th anniversary of the SSIC Training Center, inaugurated in 1976. For the anniversary, a program open to the public is planned, with lunch provided. At 15, the TicinoSkills 2026 awards ceremony will take place, on the same day dedicated to visiting the workshops and the regional skills championships. The initiative will thus bring together in the same place orientation, observation of the skills acquired during training and a celebration of the history of the center inaugurated in 1976. ## Open days and internships
### Visits to the centers
The upcoming open days are distributed among Bellinzona, Locarno and Lodrino. The program lists appointments dedicated to visits to training centers, a practical experience in the vehicle bodywork sector and the presentation of apprenticeships in technical fields. The dates and activities reported by Millestrade are as follows.
| Date | Location or organizer | Proposal | |---|---|---| | 10 October | Centro di formazione login, Officine FFS di Bellinzona | Visit to the center | | 17 October | Schindler Formazione Professionale, Locarno | Open day at the center | | 17 October | Carrosserie Suisse | «A day as a bodywork technician» | | 14 November and 12 December | Carrosserie Suisse | Repeat of the initiative | | 24 October | RUAG, Lodrino | Apprenticeships in engineering, mechanics, automation and logistics |
On 10 October, it will therefore be possible to visit the Centro di formazione login at the Officine FFS di Bellinzona. On 17 October, Schindler Formazione Professionale will open the doors of its center in Locarno. On the same date, Carrosserie Suisse will offer «A day as a bodywork technician», an experience designed to provide a practical introduction to bodywork professions. The initiative will be repeated on Saturday 14 November and Saturday 12 December. On 24 October, in Lodrino, RUAG will instead provide an opportunity to learn about various apprenticeships in the fields of engineering, mechanics, automation and logistics.
### Technical internships
Alongside the visits, the calendar includes internships at AGIE Charmilles in Losone. From 6 to 8 October, the appointments will be dedicated to polymechanics; on 8 and 9 October, the focus will be on mechanical design, while on 28 and 29 October it will be electronics. The dates thus distribute the activities across three distinct pathways, keeping separate the sessions dedicated to polymechanics, mechanical design and electronics.
On 20 and 21 October, the Centro di formazione professionale Schindler in Locarno will also organize an internship dedicated to the professions of electronics technician AFC and automation operator AFC. Here too, the appointment is included in Millestrade's calendar among the opportunities to gain direct insight into different activities and professional contexts. The visits and internships are not concentrated in a single center: Bellinzona, Locarno, Lodrino and Losone host different offerings, with companies and facilities presenting their respective training areas. ### RSI Initiatives
The October calendar also includes several opportunities to explore the world of media through RSI's activities. The Orientation Days on October 9th and 30th will allow visitors to tour the studios, learn about the professions within the company, and meet apprentices. The proposal thus combines access to workplaces, the presentation of professions, and interaction with those who are undergoing their training.
With 'Explore Your Future' (Esplora il tuo futuro), on October 16th, girls and boys aged 14 to 20 will be able to discover how a promo is created. On October 21st, they can spend a day on the set of the TV quiz show 'Blackout'. Furthermore, from October 28th, 'You with Us' (Voi da Noi) will kick off, featuring a practical workshop dedicated to creating a video application. These are three distinct appointments, spread throughout the month, that allow participants to learn about promo production, activity on a TV set, and the creation of a video application.
On October 21st, two other orientation opportunities are also scheduled. In Locarno, UBS will present its commercial apprenticeship, while in Bellinzona, an afternoon with the Cantonal Police will be held for girls and boys in their third and fourth years of middle school. Finally, on October 28th, in Manno, UBS will offer a meeting dedicated to IT apprenticeships. The initiatives thus involve media, commerce, the Cantonal Police, and IT, with events aimed at specific age groups and interests as indicated in the calendar.
Millestrade reports that the calendar is continuously updated. All appointments, details, and registration methods are available on the dedicated portal. The source also indicates the possibility of subscribing to 'Informed Parents' (Genitori informati), the newsletter of the Office for School and Professional Orientation, to receive notifications about events, information, and advice on school and career choices.

item.title: Switzerland votes on neutrality and food
item.description: Today Switzerland votes on neutrality and a food initiative (70% self-sufficiency in 10 years); nine cantons are also deciding on cantonal issues, including cross-border mobility.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Switzerland is voting today on neutrality and food. - The food initiative aims for 70% within ten years. - Neutrality links sanctions to UN decisions. - In nine cantons, voters are also voting on cantonal issues.
## Key facts - Federal issues → neutrality and food - Threshold → 70% food self-sufficiency within ten years - Economic sanctions → only if decided by the UN Security Council - Cantons involved → nine - Support → UDC and some center-left representatives - Initiators → Franziska Herren and the association Acqua pulita per tutti - Cantonal issues → infrastructure for cross-border mobility - Other issues → spatial planning, education, contraception and hooliganism
Switzerland is voting today on two federal initiatives: the one on neutrality and the one on food. In addition to the two national issues, voters in nine cantons are being called upon to vote on cantonal matters. The report is by Keystone-ATS.
### Neutrality and sanctions The initiative on neutrality calls for a stricter application of Swiss neutrality. The text seeks to introduce a far-reaching ban on sanctions into the Constitution and provides for Switzerland to use its neutrality to play a mediating role.
If the yes vote wins, Switzerland could resort to economic sanctions only when they were decided by the UN Security Council. Measures against sanctions evasion would remain possible. Cooperation with military alliances would instead be permitted only in the event of a direct and armed attack.
The proposal is supported by the UDC and some center-left representatives. Former UDC Federal Councillor Christoph Blocher contributed to its drafting. According to the latest polls, only about one third of those eligible to vote said they were in favor, and the text is expected to face an uphill battle at the polls.
### Food and cantonal vote The latest polls also indicate a clear no to the food initiative: fewer than one third of respondents were in favor. Launched by environmentalist Franziska Herren and her association Acqua pulita per tutti, the proposal calls on the Confederation to aim for a level of food self-sufficiency of at least 70% within ten years.
The Confederation should also promote a diet based more heavily on plant-based products. The agricultural and food sectors should adapt, while subsidies should be structured according to the same principles. The Confederation would also be required to guarantee everyone in Switzerland a supply of food and clean drinking water.
The cantonal issues range from spatial planning to education, from contraception to hooliganism, as well as infrastructure for cross-border mobility. Among the most eagerly awaited votes are the proposal for a substantial reduction in taxes in the Canton of Vaud and the extension of voting rights to sixteen-year-olds in Graubünden. Word about cross-border mobility infrastructure creates the only explicit connection to the lives of those crossing the border. It is a real connection, but limited: the source does not indicate the canton involved, the work, the calendar, the result of the vote or the type of infrastructure. For a cross-border worker, therefore, the data allows us to recognize the issue, not to calculate a change in the journey.
### The perimeter for those crossing the border The reference appears among the cantonal objects, alongside territorial planning, training, contraception and hooliganism. This distinguishes cross-border mobility from the two federal objects. The consultation on neutrality concerns the regulation of sanctions, Switzerland's role as mediator and collaboration with military alliances in the event of a direct and armed attack. The one on nutrition concerns self-sufficiency, plant products, the agricultural and food sector, subsidies, foodstuffs and drinking water.
The text does not allow any of these elements to be transformed into an announcement on works, routes, times or effects already decided. He does not say whether the rumor on mobility concerns the Canton of Ticino and does not name Brogeda. Even the result is not yet reported: the source describes a day of voting and only reports the forecasts of the latest polls.
### Topics that remain outside The delimitation is useful for a cross-border worker who seeks effects on his personal position. The source does not come under G permit, AVS, LPP, KVG, refunds, withholding tax, INPS or double taxation. It does not even deal with a new 2026 tax deal. These dossiers cannot be linked to the vote based on the text provided.
For the same reason, reference to cantonal objects does not authorize the deduction of timetables, construction sites, diversions, costs, waiting times or procedures. Anyone who wants to compare the general topic of mobility with their own commuting can consult the mezzi pubblici Ticino section, while keeping the practical function of the tool separate from the content of the consultation.
## Useful planning tools To estimate your pension strategy, use the pension planner and the pillar 3 simulator. To properly follow the day, a cross-border commuter can use a simple sequence, limited to the information actually present in the source. The text contains neither definitive results nor operational instructions regarding documents or offices: the possible action is therefore to organize the reading and separate what is written from what is not specified.
### Four reading steps 1. Start with the federal items. Keep the question on neutrality separate from the one on food supply. The first should be read through the broad ban on sanctions, the role of mediator, and the rule on economic sanctions decided by the UN Security Council. The second should be read through the objective of at least 70% food self-sufficiency within ten years and the measures concerning plant-based products, agriculture, food, subsidies, foodstuffs and drinking water.
2. Then move on to the cantonal items. The source speaks of nine cantons and different subject matters. Isolate the item on infrastructure for cross-border mobility, because it is the one directly connected to those who cross the border.
3. Preserve the level of precision of the news. Do not associate the item with a specific canton, a specific infrastructure or an effect that has already been decided: these elements are not indicated. Do not replace the latest poll predictions with a result.
4. Separate practical monitoring from the electoral data. To monitor commuting, you can consult tempi attesa valichi; that reference concerns daily mobility and does not add details to the cantonal question. The distinction avoids attributing to the vote construction sites, detours, schedules or costs that the text does not mention.
The criterion also applies to future interpretation: any eventual outcome should be read only together with the details that will become available on the cantonal issue. As long as the source remains general, the only operational fact is the presence of cross-border mobility among the issues being voted on.

## The connection with the Binda Cycling Festival
### Sport, culture and the local area
The exhibition at Villa Mirabello is part of the Binda Cycling Festival 2026 program. The project accompanies the Tre Valli Varesine with initiatives that concern not only sport, but also extend to culture, photography, the local area and solidarity.
